title: REQ · Grid sources become PNG files and manifest entries with real size and frame data
summary: A registry of grid sources plus pure planning and manifest merge functions
description: Context: no grid source files exist. Desired behavior: src/art/sources.ts exports palette-indexed grid sources (id, path, frames); a pure generateAssets turns them through gridToRgba, buildSpriteSheet and encodePng into file bytes plus manifest entries; mergeManifest replaces entries by id and keeps others. Why: gives the script a testable core.
acceptance_criteria: Given a source with 4 frames of 32x48, when planned, then the entry has dimensions 128x48 and frames 32,48,4 and type spritesheet
Given a single-frame source, when planned, then the entry is type image with its dimensions
Given a manifest holding the same id, when merged, then that entry is replaced in place and other entries stay unchanged
Given a source with an index beyond the palette, when planned, then it throws

in_scope: art source registry with one seed hand-cursor source
out_of_scope: the room, boy and UI art sets

technical_constraints: Sources use indices into the shared PALETTE of at most 48 colours
Manifest entries must satisfy assetSchema in game/src/assets/manifest/schema.ts
All art generated in-repo; no downloaded art
